title: Minimal time for heat observability on almost-Riemannian surfaces
summary: We determine the minimal observation time for the heat equation on a closed almost-Riemannian surface, for a class of observation sets leaving sufficiently thin collars around simple Baouendi-Grushin circles. The structure and density are analytic near these circles, and the coefficients may depend on both variables. The formula is expressed through a complex phase describing concentration near the singular set and extends the thresholds known for separated models.
